title: the local secrets config (${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/hapi/secrets.yaml)
description: Picks the secret provider and binds it (spec §11.5). It lives outside the repo and holds no secret. Exactly the selected provider's block is set: hapi refuses any other block. A path may start with ~ (your HOME); a relative path is relative to this file's directory. See docs/secrets.md.

provider.description: sops (the default: one age-encrypted file), bws (Bitwarden Secrets Manager) or env-file (a plaintext 0600 file outside every checkout: an audited downgrade).

sops.description: The sops provider: the encrypted file, and the age key that opens it.

age_key_file.description: The age key file. Default: sops's own, ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/sops/age/keys.txt. It must be yours, with no group or other permission bits, and outside the hapi-factory checkout.

bws.description: The bws provider: which Bitwarden Secrets Manager secret id holds each logical name. BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN comes from the environment only.

ids.description: Logical name -> bws secret id (a UUID).

env_file.description: The env-file provider (a downgrade): a plaintext file of NAME='value' lines, NAME being the logical name upper-cased with '-' as '_'. Mode 0600, yours, outside every checkout.

path.description: A file path: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the config file's directory.
